name: Age Differences In Relationships
overview: Scripture acknowledges age differences in relationships, as seen in Abraham's astonishment at the prospect of fathering a child at one hundred years old alongside Sarah, who was ninety (Genesis 17:17). While physical attraction is cautioned against in Proverbs 6:25, true relationships are grounded in God's love and purpose, exemplified by the gift of His Son for eternal life (John 3:16). The revelation of Christ's plan to His servants (Revelation 1:1) reminds believers to seek divine guidance in all aspects of life, including relationships that span age differences.
